name: io.github.youhaozhao/cninfo-mcp
title: CNINFO 巨潮资讯 (unofficial)
description: Unofficial server for China A-share research on CNINFO: filings, report text, financials, holders.

environmentVariables.name: CNINFO_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory that downloaded files are confined to. Defaults to ~/Downloads/cninfo-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: CNINFO_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory for security lists and fetched documents. Defaults to the platform cache directory.
